say:1:1430238401:1.text: I went to a party of great men and ladies. However, it's not what I expected at all!
say:1:1430238401:1.source_cn: 我参加了所谓的贵族宴会，可……跟我想的完全不一样！
say:1:1430238401:1.male: I went to a party of great men and ladies. However, it's not what I expected at all!
say:1:1430238401:1.female: I went to a party of great men and ladies. However, it's not what I expected at all!

say:2:1430238402:1.text: All the lords and ladies were showing their uncertainty and anxiety. Every single one of them is worried about what to do next.
say:2:1430238402:1.source_cn: 那些高高在上的贵族聚在一起满脸焦虑，他们都在担心今后该...
say:2:1430238402:1.male: All the lords and ladies were showing their uncertainty and anxiety. Every single one of them is worried about what to do next.
say:2:1430238402:1.female: All the lords and ladies were showing their uncertainty and anxiety. Every single one of them is worried about what to do next.

say:3:1430238403:1.text: They're all too busy helping themselves. No one is willing to help me!
say:3:1430238403:1.source_cn: 他们自顾不暇，哪儿还有什么愿意帮助我的贵人！
say:3:1430238403:1.male: They're all too busy helping themselves. No one is willing to help me!
say:3:1430238403:1.female: They're all too busy helping themselves. No one is willing to help me!
